workspaceHeaderFade: The workspace list paints a theme-matched soft gradient below the grouping/search controls. It fades in with the initial scroll offset and keeps clipped rows from meeting a hard header edge without changing list padding or hit targets.
launcherTransition: The Intent button morphs between the iOS 80dp circle and 48dp rounded-square close state, with coordinated glyph rotation, shrink and crossfade, a response-0.35/damping-0.85 spring, reversible animation and Android system duration-scale support. Per user direction, its open state uses the shared neutral grey surface and matching foreground, blended with the same animation progress. The modal keeps its anchor through both transitions, fades its scrim/tiles and preserves existing dismissal/action behavior.
notes: Android remains under development. The Intent menu close button uses the exact custom Close.svg path and 1.995 stroke from the referenced iOS asset, retaining theme tint and the existing morph animation. The Intent launcher now transitions between the referenced iOS circle/dandelion and rounded-square/close states with reversible spring motion, coordinated size/rotation/scale/crossfade, animated overlay entrance and system animation-scale support. Workspace rows omit description/status-message paragraphs, matching WorkspaceRowView; details retain the full summary. Workspace list corrections use iOS IntentDandelion artwork, left/right edge drawers with accessible heading actions, and Search beside Recent/Repo/Status with grouping preserved. Android retains system Back outside the central gesture exclusion area; archive actions remain in the heading menu.
